race.comment: Siding with BEV'S NINE (3) who has built a fantastic winning record with six wins from eight starts, going to the paddock off a Listed win at Scone. He's a fast gelding who comes down and finds a winnable race with Blake Shinn booked. BEHAVIOUR (11) is flying. He's won two of his past three, too strong back to 1000m last time. Stays right down in the weights and 1100m is even better. Very hard to hold out again. WINNASEDGE (2) is off a let up having last been seen chasing home Cosmic Crusader in the G3 Bletchingly Stakes. Two wins prior over this route were good and he should run well. SPYWIRE (1) resumes having run fourth in The Quokka before a spell. Big weight here is the query but have to respect. DON'T HOPE DO (7) faded first up but can be in this for longer.
